subject: Air freight quote to SGN
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well. Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to SGN (Ho Chi Minh City, VN), including a truck you arrange from our site in 24646 (Kiel), Germany, to the departure airport?

The shipment is 4 pieces of electronic control units, with a gross weight of 1082 kg and a total volume of 4.41 cbm. It’ll be ready for pickup on 2026-11-23.

Thanks for taking a look!

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
